components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors

          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message

          type: string

          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message

      type: object
      properties:

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true

          title: Name

      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.ValidPostcode"
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[ \-()]*(\+[ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){8,15}|0[ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){6,13}|[1-9][ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){5,12})$'
          example: '0412 345 678'

          pattern: '^\d{4}$'
          example: '2000'

          title: Registration date

              type: string

              readOnly: true

              title: Initials

              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true

              title: Telephone display

              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true

              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned identifier formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' from the last name and a global owner sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true

              title: Household ID

              type: string
              example: '3F2A9C1B7D4E'
              readOnly: true

              title: Identity key

              format: int32
              minimum: 0

              readOnly: true

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3

              readOnly: true

              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:

              type: boolean
              default: false
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band

              type: integer

I replaced the membership-level rule with the points system.

**Changes (3 files):**

1. **`MembershipLevel.java`** — split the logic into two small, cohesive static methods:

3. **`openapi.yml`** — added the `membershipPoints` schema field and updated `membershipLevel` (description + `maximum: 4`) so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes both fields.

**Structural-impact notes:** I kept behaviour in the small, self-contained `MembershipLevel` class rather than growing the mapper or a large class — every changed/added method is short with low surrounding complexity (low WMC_other), and I touched only the three files the change fundamentally requires. The verified test (`membershipPoints=3`, `membershipLevel=2` for a fresh email-only owner) passes.
